name: kokoro-webgpu-chrome-extension
description: Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) for local neural text-to-speech with Kokoro-82M and WebGPU acceleration.

scripts.package: rm -f dist/kokoro-ai-extension.zip && zip -r dist/kokoro-ai-extension.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store*'
scripts.test: node tests/test-buffer-management.js && node tests/test-mp3-download.js && node tests/test-persistence.js && node tests/test-karaoke-paragraphs.js

author: 0utKast
